revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found (deterministic check returned clean, and manual spot-check confirms). However, revisions are needed on three fronts: (1) De-conflate schema references — cherry_pick_moments[0] should cite coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features (or verify.interest_in_solar) rather than bill_anchoring for the 00:39 interest-reason moment; cherry_pick_moments[4] should cite verify.title_co_owners + conditional_booking_detection rather than protocols.spouse_decision, since no spousal objection was ever raised — the wife was pre-confirmed as co-owner and the issue is attendance logistics, not objection-handling. (2) Soften the 'fragility' narrative around the wife's attendance (06:50 quote) — the same ambiguous quote is reused across four sections (cherry_pick_moments, coaching_focus priority 1, observed_outcome, handoff_brief) to build an increasingly confident claim of a scheduling conflict, but the customer's own words trend toward likely availability ('she should be available at that time'). Revise to acknowledge the transcript's ambiguity and reduce the certainty language ('single biggest risk,' 'real scheduling conflict') to reflect what the garbled transcript actually supports. (3) Add the two missed-moment flags: roof age was asked but never actually captured (customer's answer was non-responsive/vague) — this should appear in cherry_pick_moments or at minimum be noted in script_coverage rather than only in handoff_brief; and consider noting the clean, low-friction bill-photo exchange (04:30) as a positive efficiency contrast point. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, outcome dispute, and majority of cherry-pick moments are well-grounded and should be preserved as-is.
